L1.name: The product is wrong
L1.example: Include incorrect multiplication (4 × 6 shown as 14 instead of 24) and reversed digits (3 × 4 shown as 21 instead of 12, or 3 × 2 shown as 60 instead of 6). Use one option: “The product is wrong.” Propagate the displayed product through the totals; correction feedback gives the correct product and its tens/units.

L2.name: Carry omitted from the next diagonal
L2.example: In 89 × 7, the units diagonal totals 13 but its carry is omitted from the tens diagonal. Include that carry to obtain 623.

L3.name: Right-hand factor digits written bottom-up
L3.example: Lay out 34 × 16 as 34 × 61, obtaining 2074 instead of 544. Repair the factor order; the resulting cells are consequences.

L4.name: Oversized carry read as an extra answer digit
L4.example: In 76 × 7, correctly calculate the diagonal totals but copy the full-size carry into the answer, giving 5132 instead of 532. Distinguish carry notation from output digits.

L6.name: Adding a digit along the wrong diagonal
L6.example: In 23 × 4, include the units 2 from the 12 cell in the tens diagonal instead of the units diagonal, producing 110 rather than 92. Add each triangular entry exactly once in its own diagonal.

L7.name: Adding a carry twice
L7.example: In 76 × 7, the tens diagonal totals 13 and carries 1. Add that carry twice to the hundreds diagonal: 4 + 1 + 1 = 6, producing 632 instead of 532. Include it once: 4 + 1 = 5.

L8.name: Dropping an internal zero when reading the answer
L8.example: The lattice for 101 × 2 correctly gives hundreds 2, tens 0, units 2, but the answer is copied as 22. Retain the zero to give 202. A variant may insert an extra internal zero despite correct totals.

reasons.a-carry-has-been-missed-from-the-next: A carry has been missed from the next diagonal.
reasons.the-right-hand-number-is-written-bottom-: The right-hand number is written bottom-up.
reasons.not-write-in-the-tens-half-and-in: {0} × {1} = {2}, not {3}. Write {4} in the tens half and {5} in the units half.
reasons.append-the-carry-as-another-answer-digit: Append the carry as another answer digit.
reasons.the-incoming-carry-has-been-included-twi: The incoming carry has been included twice — add it only once.
reasons.write-the-right-hand-factor-digits-top-t: Write the right-hand factor digits top to bottom in their original order.
reasons.remove-a-zero-from-the-right-hand-factor: Remove a zero from the right-hand factor.
reasons.add-the-carry-to-the-diagonal-a-second: Add the carry to the diagonal a second time.
reasons.the-carry-is-not-an-extra-answer-digit: The carry is not an extra answer digit — keep it small and use it only in its diagonal sum.
reasons.delete-the-carry-from-the-diagonal-sum-a: Delete the carry from the diagonal sum as well.
reasons.move-the-misplaced-cell-digit-back-to-it: Move the misplaced cell digit back to its own diagonal; include every entry once.
reasons.reverse-the-order-of-all-answer-digits: Reverse the order of all answer digits.
reasons.the-units-digit-from-row-column-belongs-: The units digit {0} from row {1}, column {2} belongs in the {3},{4}s diagonal, not the {5},{6}s diagonal. Include it once.
reasons.move-the-zero-to-the-end-of-the: Move the zero to the end of the answer.
reasons.retain-the-zero-output-digit-in-its-plac: Retain the zero output digit in its place when reading the answer.
reasons.remove-every-zero-from-the-final-answer: Remove every zero from the final answer.
reasons.keep-every-output-digit-including-the-in: Keep every output digit, including the internal zeros: {0},{1},{2}.
reasons.append-the-incoming-carry-as-an-extra-an: Append the incoming carry as an extra answer digit.
reasons.include-the-incoming-carry-once-in-this-: Include the incoming carry once in this diagonal’s sum.
reasons.include-the-incoming-carry-once-in-the-s: Include the incoming carry {0} once in the {1}s diagonal.
reasons.the-incoming-carry-was-counted-twice-in-: The incoming carry {0} was counted twice in the {1},{2}s diagonal. Include it once.
reasons.include-the-incoming-carry-once-in-the-s: Include the incoming carry {0} once in the {1},{2}s diagonal.
reasons.write-from-top-to-bottom-recalculate-the: Write {0} from top to bottom: {1}, {2}, {3}. Recalculate the cells using this order.
reasons.the-carry-belongs-in-the-s-diagonal-sum: The carry {0} belongs in the {1},{2}s diagonal sum, not as an extra digit in the answer.
